verdicts.one_line: MIT Python client wrapping the official (paid) SimilarWeb API for domain traffic/engagement metrics; no data committed, requires a paid API key.
verdicts.abnb_use: Would give web-traffic/engagement estimates for airbnb.com (gap 5) if the team ever obtains a SimilarWeb key; produces nothing without one.
verdicts.sample_plan: No public sample possible — every endpoint requires a paid SimilarWeb key; catalogue as a method to revisit only if a key is obtained.
verdicts.reasoning: Useful method pointer for gap 5 but gated entirely behind a paid API key, so no agent can pull anything from it now.

verdicts.one_line: Mirror of the GoiEner (Zenodo, CC-BY) hourly smart-meter dataset for 25,559 households in Basque Country/Navarre, Spain, Nov 2014-Jun 2022, ~15GB unpacked.
verdicts.abnb_use: Template/comparator for a smart-meter-as-occupancy-proxy method (gap 8-adjacent), but the panel is mixed residential, not touristic, and non-Spain, non-ABNB-market geography limits direct use.
verdicts.sample_plan: Not worth an agent pull: geography is not a covered market, mix is residential not touristic, and the dataset is large (2GB+ compressed) relative to the weak read-through — catalogue only.
verdicts.reasoning: Genuine open granular utility panel and a real method template, but wrong geography/population for an ABNB occupancy proxy and too large to justify a sample on that thin a connection.

verdicts.abnb_use: Could support gap 5 (engagement proxy: pageviews on 'Airbnb', 'Vrbo', destination-city articles) as a point-in-time-clean interest series.
verdicts.sample_plan: Skip this specific stale wrapper; if sampled, pull directly from the official Wikimedia REST API (see WikiPageviews entry) rather than through this client.
verdicts.reasoning: The load-bearing artifact is the official free Wikimedia API itself, not this particular stale wrapper repo, so cataloguing it as the pointer is enough.

verdicts.one_line: Thin, recently-touched (Apr 2026) wrapper around the official keyless Wikimedia Pageviews REST API, daily per-article counts back to July 2015.
verdicts.abnb_use: Gap 5 engagement proxy: pull daily pageviews for 'Airbnb', 'Vrbo', 'Short-term_rental' and a few destination-city articles as a point-in-time-clean search-interest series to compare against nights/ADR nowcasts.
verdicts.sample_plan: Skip cloning this repo; instead do a direct keyless GET against https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/metrics/pageviews/per-article/en.wikipedia/all-access/all-agents/<article>/daily/2018010100/2026091400 for 4-5 articles (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Short-term_rental) and save as CSV, well under 5MB.
verdicts.reasoning: Wikimedia's pageviews API is public, keyless, and genuinely point-in-time, matching gap 5 directly and cheap enough to sample now even though this specific client repo is not itself load-bearing.
